entries.title: Matthew 15:1
segments: Then some Pharisees and Teachers of the Law came to Jesus, and said:

entries.title: Matthew 15:2
segments: "How is it that your disciples break the traditions of our ancestors? For they do not wash their hands when they eat food."

entries.title: Matthew 15:3
segments: His reply was: "How is it that you on your side break God's commandments out of respect for your own traditions?

entries.title: Matthew 15:4
segments: For God said--'Honor thy father and mother,' and 'Let him who reviles his father or mother suffer death,'

entries.title: Matthew 15:5
segments: But you say 'Whenever any one says to his father or mother "Whatever of mine might have been of service to you is 'Given to God,'"

entries.title: Matthew 15:6
segments: He is in no way bound to honor his father.' In this way you have nullified the words of God on account of your traditions.

entries.title: Matthew 15:7
segments: Hypocrites! It was well said by Isaiah when he prophesied about you--

entries.title: Matthew 15:8
segments: 'This is a people that honor me with their lips, While their hearts are far removed from me;

entries.title: Matthew 15:9
segments: But vainly do they worship me, For they teach but the precepts of men.'"

entries.title: Matthew 15:10
segments: Then Jesus called the people to him, and said: "Listen, and mark my words.

entries.title: Matthew 15:11
segments: It is not what enters a man's mouth that 'defiles' him, but what comes out from his mouth--that does defile him!"

entries.title: Matthew 15:12
segments: On this his disciples came up to him, and said: "Do you know that the Pharisees were shocked on hearing what you said?"

entries.title: Matthew 15:13
segments: "Every plant," Jesus replied, "that my heavenly Father has not planted will be rooted up.

entries.title: Matthew 15:14
segments: Let them be; they are but blind guides; and, if one blind man guides another, both of them will fall into a ditch."

entries.title: Matthew 15:15
segments: Upon this, Peter said to Jesus: "Explain this saying to us."

entries.title: Matthew 15:16
segments: "What, do even you understand nothing yet? Jesus exclaimed.

entries.title: Matthew 15:17
segments: "Do not you see that whatever goes into the mouth passes into the stomach, and is afterwards expelled?

entries.title: Matthew 15:18
segments: But the things that come out from the mouth proceed from the heart, and it is these that defile a man;

entries.title: Matthew 15:19
segments: For out of the heart proceed evil thoughts--murder, adultery, unchastity, theft, perjury, slander.

entries.title: Matthew 15:20
segments: These are the things that defile a man; but eating with unwashed hands does not defile a man."

entries.title: Matthew 15:21
segments: On going away from that place, Jesus retired to the country round Tyre and Sidon.

entries.title: Matthew 15:22
segments: There, a Canaanite woman of that district came out and began calling to Jesus: "Take pity on me, Master, Son of David; my daughter is grievously possessed by a demon."

entries.title: Matthew 15:23
segments: But Jesus did not answer her a word; and his disciples came up and begged him to send her away. "She keeps calling out after us," they said.

entries.title: Matthew 15:24
segments: "I was not sent," replied Jesus, "to any one except the lost sheep of Israel."

entries.title: Matthew 15:25
segments: But the woman came, and, bowing to the ground before him, said: "Master, help me."

entries.title: Matthew 15:26
segments: "It is not fair," replied Jesus, "to take the children's food and throw it to dogs."

entries.title: Matthew 15:27
segments: "Yes, Master," she said, "for even dogs do feed on the scraps that fall from their owners' table."

entries.title: Matthew 15:28
segments: "Your faith is great," was his reply to the woman; "it shall be as you wish!" And her daughter was cured that very hour.

entries.title: Matthew 15:29
segments: On leaving that place, Jesus went to the shore of the Sea of Galilee; and then went up the hill, and sat down., you will do what not only what has been done to the fig tree, but, even if you should say to this hill 'Be lifted up and hurled into the sea!' it would be done.

entries.title: Matthew 15:30
segments: Great crowds of people came to him, bringing with them those who were lame, crippled, blind, or dumb, and many others. They put them down at his feet, and he cured them;

entries.title: Matthew 15:31
segments: And the crowds were astonished, when they saw the dumb talking, the cripples made sound, the lame walking about, and the blind with their sight restored; and they praised the God of Israel.

entries.title: Matthew 15:32
segments: Afterwards Jesus called his disciples to him, and said: "My heart is moved at the sight of all these people, for they have already been with me three days and they have nothing to eat; and I am unwilling to send them away hungry, for fear that they should break down on the way."

entries.title: Matthew 15:33
segments: "Where can we," his disciples asked, "in a lonely place find enough bread for such a crowd as this?"

entries.title: Matthew 15:34
segments: "How many loaves have you?" said Jesus. "Seven," they answered, "and a few small fish."

entries.title: Matthew 15:35
segments: Telling the crowd to sit down on the ground,

entries.title: Matthew 15:36
segments: Jesus took the seven loaves and the fish, and, after saying the thanksgiving, broke them, and gave them to the disciples; and the disciples gave them to the crowds.

entries.title: Matthew 15:37
segments: Every one had sufficient to eat, and they picked up seven baskets full of the broken pieces left.

entries.title: Matthew 15:38
segments: The men who ate were four thousand in number without counting women and children.

entries.title: Matthew 15:39
segments: Then, after dismissing the crowds, Jesus got into the boat, and went to the neighborhood of Magadan.
